quotes.text: The previous and next Today Pane cyclers change meaning as the mode changes. The accepted code picks localized tooltip keys by the current index, using (index + 2) % 3 and (index + 1) % 3, then sets each button attribute. It adds a separate localized close tooltip and registers the new FTL resource in messenger.xhtml. Current JS retains this mapping. When a control cycles modes, update its label to describe the action it will take next, and load its localization resource where the control appears.
